title: assay: draft-mahy-mimi-identity-05
description: Per the epic's output contract. Local: ~/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-mimi-identity-05.txt (confirm -05 is latest in the retrieval bead). Known hooks to check against: decision mimid-1wgh.6.1 / H1 (credential identity = user URI; BasicCredential only), JM-1 .12.19, clientUri derivation .7.8 (INVENTED), hub credential identity mimi://<domain> (.6.35), wg beads .37.67/.37.70 and mimi-protocol#150 (credential identity for clients, hub, franking agent), mimi-protocol#159 and localfix .13.6 (how a domain comes out of a credential; rohanmahy: 'personally I think basic credential is a menace'), AGENTS.md 'BasicCredential only' and 'no authentication between providers' known weaknesses. Key question for the decision bead: does the draft give mimid a path off BasicCredential (X.509 / SD-CWT / other) and a credential-to-domain rule, and at what cost.
